fields.description: Which known gateway this connector points at. These options are the enabled entries of jarvis.connectors.catalog plus "Custom URL"; a drift test fails if the two disagree. "Custom URL" allows any admin-approved endpoint.

fields.label: Scope
fields.description: Shared: one connector for the whole tenant, credential set by an admin, visible (read-only) to every user. Personal: owned by one user, invisible to everyone else. A Personal connector wins over a Shared one with the same key for that user.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Disabled connectors are never dispatched to, regardless of the site-wide kill switch.

fields.label: Auth Method
fields.description: How this connector authenticates. "API Key": a bearer token/PAT stored in Credential (the shipped path), or no credential at all for an open preset. "OAuth": a browser Connect flow whose tokens live in a linked Connected App or an MCP OAuth Client, chosen by the preset's catalog class; Credential is unused either way. A token or open preset has no sign-in and the controller rejects "OAuth" on one. Broker branches on this; unset rows are treated as API Key.

fields.label: Connected App
fields.description: The Frappe Connected App backing this connector's OAuth grant, on the connected_app-class presets only (see jarvis.connectors.catalog). Every other sign-in preset, and Custom URL, uses MCP OAuth Client instead and must leave this empty - the controller rejects a row carrying the wrong link, or both.

fields.label: MCP OAuth Client
fields.description: The discovered OAuth configuration backing this connector's sign-in, on Custom URL and on the dcr/static presets (see jarvis.connectors.catalog). SERVER-SET: written by the connectors API after discovery, never accepted from a client, and the controller rejects any value naming a client that belongs to a different connector.

fields.label: Base URL
fields.description: The gateway's HTTP(S) endpoint, e.g. https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp. Must be http:// or https://.

fields.label: Credential
fields.description: Bearer token/PAT for this connector, stored encrypted. Never returned by any API; read only via get_password server-side.

fields.label: Allowed Actions
fields.description: Per-action allow list, deny by default. Populated from the connector's tools/list result; only actions marked Allowed here may be called.

fields.label: Last Test Status
fields.description: Outcome of the last connection test (initialize + tools/list). Server-set only.

fields.label: Tools Cache
fields.description: Last tools/list result from this connector, server-set only. Used to validate call arguments and to render the allowed-actions picker.
